name: acasystem
description: Acasystem: Home Assistant con un frontend migliorato (da Tunet 1.22.1, GPL-3.0)

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w casa3d
scripts.test: npm run test -w frontend && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w casa3d
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w casa3d
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w backend
